title: East to Garajau or West to Cabo Girão: Which Is Better by Boat?
description: West suits a short trip with swims: cliffs, fajãs and shelter in 2h30 to 3h. East has the Garajau reserve, where motor boats may not cruise, and more wind.
heroAlt: The Garajau coast with the Cristo Rei statue on its clifftop, seen from the sea

images.prompt: Seen from the sea off Ponta do Lazareto on a clear morning, looking east along the Garajau coast: brown and green cliffs drop to a calm, deep blue sea, and the white Cristo Rei statue stands small on the clifftop of Ponta do Garajau with its arms open. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy sits well offshore at the left edge of the frame, outside the reserve. Soft morning light, true colours, realistic photo, no text.
images.alt: The Garajau coast with the Cristo Rei statue on its clifftop, seen from the sea
